thread:
sarah: oncall bot paged me - embeddings QPS spike from tenant: cust-phi-42, backend latency jumping, some 503s. seeing tail on redis cache miss too.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: prod /v1/embeddings elevated error rate (>5% over 5m) - paged eng-oncall. playbook: inspect route, isolate tenant if possible, consider per-endpoint quota carve.

kevin: on it. grabbing logs and perf. can we shard that tenant off a lower qps or put them to best-effort?

sarah: yes - priority is keep chat & rerank healthy. embeddings are noisy. recommend: - reduce cust-phi-42 embeddings quota to 10 qps - carve 50% of their capacity from embeddings route - if needed disable rerank for that tenant (they use concurrently)

dave: agreed. i'm going to push a per-tenant override in control plane. command:```http
POST /admin/quotas/overrides
{ "tenant": "cust-phi-42", "route": "/v1/embeddings", "qps": 10, "duration_s": 1200 }
```

maria: heads-up to CS: some customers on premium logs might see embeddings timeouts, chat should be unaffected after carve. i'll draft a quick note.

kevin: applying now. watching metrics.

ops-bot: ACTION: quota override applied for cust-phi-42 /v1/embeddings -> 10 qps (ttl 1200s) by dave.

kevin: immediate drop in embeddings error rate, latency improving. chat and rerank p99 stable. looks like the noisy tenant was exhausting worker slots and causing KV cache thrash.

sarah: great. follow-up: schedule tenant throttling in policy so it auto-escalates if pattern repeats. also create a canary rule: tenants over X embeddings qps get auto-deprioritized to best-effort when cluster saturates.

dave: filing short runbook item. will add a per-route emergency throttle procedure and command snippets.

maria: CS note sent to affected AEs and PMs: "We applied temporary quota limits for a single tenant to protect service; we're monitoring and will restore when stable."

kevin: re-enable rerank for that tenant? they had rerank enabled in pipeline but we didn't touch it. we disabled embeddings throughput only.

sarah: leave rerank alone for now. if we see rerank errors next, we'll toggle it off.

ops-bot: MONITOR: embeddings error rate <1% for 3m post-change.

kevin: i'm going to run a targeted fair-share tweak for embeddings route: shift 20% capacity from low-priority slices to the default slice to evenly absorb bursts. command:```sh
./ctl route adjust-slices --route /v1/embeddings --shift default +20% --from slice:batching-lowpr
```

kevin: applied. metrics look stable. no broad customer impact.

sarah: excellent. post-incident actions: 1) add tenant rate anomaly alert, 2) ramp docs for emergency per-tenant carve, 3) consider per-route circuit breaker to automatically soft-disable rerank when embeddings queue depth > X.

maria: noted and adding to the incident ticket. tagging upstream: @billing-team to check if customer spike is expected (billing job, backfill?).

kevin: will keep this thread open for 30m then close if stable. nice quick mitigation folks :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated - embeddings error rate normalized after per-tenant carve and slice shift. incident will be marked resolved if no regressions in 30m.

sarah: closing summary for the ticket: temporary per-tenant quota applied; slice rebalancing performed; no customer-visible impact beyond limited embeddings slowdown for cust-phi-42; runbook and alerting follow-ups created.

maria: thanks. closing on my end once CS confirms outreach acked.
